questions.question: Who became the first African artist to receive the Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award?
questions.questionHtml: Who became the first African artist to receive the Grammy Lifetime Achievement Award?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Fela Kuti.

In News

  • Music legend Fela Kuti was honored with a Lifetime Achievement Award.

Key Points

  • He is the first African artist to receive this prestigious honor.
  • Fela Kuti is renowned as the pioneer of the Afrobeat music genre.
  • The award recognizes his global influence and musical legacy.
  • Fela Kuti
    • Origin - Nigeria
    • Legacy - Afrobeat pioneer
    • Award - Lifetime Achievement

questions.question: Which Indian Army officer won the UN Secretary-General’s Award 2025 for gender-inclusive peacekeeping?
questions.questionHtml: Which Indian Army officer won the UN Secretary-General’s Award 2025 for gender-inclusive peacekeeping?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Major Swathi Shantha Kumar.

In News

  • Indian Army officer Major Swathi Shantha Kumar won the UN Secretary-General’s Award 2025 in the Gender Category for her project “Equal Partners, Lasting Peace”.

Key Points

  • Major Swathi led the Indian Engagement Team under the UN Mission in South Sudan.
  • Her leadership promoted women’s deployment and integration in peacekeeping operations.
  • Enabled effective patrols, community outreach, and safer access to conflict-affected areas.
  • Project titled “Equal Partners, Lasting Peace” was selected among nominations from all UN peacekeeping missions worldwide.

Additional Information

  • UN Secretary-General’s Award – Recognizes outstanding peacekeepers promoting inclusivity and effectiveness.
  • Gender-inclusive Peacekeeping – Focuses on integration of women to enhance operational efficiency and community trust.
  • Indian Engagement Team – India contributes personnel to UN peacekeeping missions globally.
  • Significance – First-time international recognition for India in gender-focused peacekeeping initiatives.

questions.question: _______________ won the 2025 UNESCO Award of Merit for its cultural heritage conservation efforts.
questions.questionHtml: _______________ won the 2025 UNESCO Award of Merit for its cultural heritage conservation efforts.

options.text: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai
options.html: Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Our Lady of Grace Cathedral, Vasai.

In News

  • The Our Lady of Grace Cathedral in Vasai, Maharashtra received the 2025 UNESCO Award of Merit for cultural heritage conservation.
  • The recognition was given under the UNESCO Asia-Pacific Awards for Cultural Heritage Conservation.

Key Highlights

  • The cathedral is a 475-year-old structure located in Papdy village, Vasai.
  • Originally built in the 16th century during the Portuguese colonial period.
  • Architectural style reflects Portuguese Baroque and Gothic influences, adapted to local climatic conditions.
  • The restoration was a community-led initiative involving local residents, church authorities, conservation experts, and historians.
  • Conservation work used traditional materials like lime mortar to maintain structural authenticity.

Significance:

  • The award highlights the importance of community participation in heritage preservation.
  • It brings international recognition to India’s cultural conservation efforts.
  • The recognition is expected to boost heritage awareness and tourism in the Vasai region.

questions.question: Project Veer Gatha is a joint initiative of which two Union Ministries to inspire school students with stories of gallantry award winners?
questions.questionHtml: Project Veer Gatha is a joint initiative of which two Union Ministries to inspire school students with stories of gallantry award winners?

options.text: Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of Culture
options.html: Ministry of Home Affairs and Ministry of Culture

options.text: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Ministry of Home Affairs
options.html: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Ministry of Home Affairs

options.text: Ministry of Education and Ministry of Defence
options.html: Ministry of Education and Ministry of Defence

options.text: Ministry of Education and Ministry of Culture
options.html: Ministry of Education and Ministry of Culture

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Ministry of Education and Ministry of Defence.

In News

  • Project Veer Gatha 5.0 (2025-26) was recently launched as a collaborative effort to disseminate stories of valor among school students across India.

Key Points

  • Project Veer Gatha was instituted in 2021 by the Ministry of Defence (MoD) in collaboration with the Ministry of Education (MoE) to foster patriotism and civic values.
  • The initiative targets students from Classes 3 to 12, encouraging them to create projects like poems, essays, paintings, and multimedia presentations on gallantry award winners.
  • The 5.0 edition (2025-26) expanded its scope to include pre-independence warriors and historical military traditions under the theme "Samarik Parampara."
  • Project Participation
    • Inception - 2021 (as part of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav)
    • Veer Gatha 5.0 Participation - Over 1.92 crore students
    • National Winners - Top 100 students known as "Super 100"

Additional Information

  • Gallantry Awards Portal (GAP)
    • Significance - The digital platform where stories of bravery are documented; Project Veer Gatha is instituted under this portal.
    • Objective - To serve as a single-window source for information on all gallantry awardees since independence.
  • Super 100 Rewards
    • Cash Prize - Rs 10,000 per winner.
    • Recognition - Felicitated jointly by the MoE and MoD in New Delhi and invited to the Republic Day Parade at Kartavya Path.
